assets.prompt: One original production sprite atlas for a small seaside lantern workshop game. Six separate well-spaced assets in EXACTLY a 3 by 2 grid on a completely flat uniform pale cream #faf0d8 background. Wide 1536 by 1024, each sprite centered within its own equal square with generous clean margins, no panel outlines. Fine paper grain, warm matte gouache, clean cut-paper silhouettes, dark pine green and warm cream with apricot and persimmon orange accents. No letters, numbers, signage, symbols, faces, text or logo. TOP LEFT: ONE single orange flat octagonal lantern glass tile, seen straight from above, dark terracotta edge, bold amber colored center and a light reflective facet. A math counting piece with only one obvious outline. TOP MIDDLE: ONE matching single mint teal flat octagonal glass tile with dark pine edge and light reflective facet, identical size and shape, seen straight from above. TOP RIGHT: ONE small empty craft trolley with wheels, rounded pine green sides, an orange handle, and two shallow bins as part of the trolley, side silhouette, no contents. BOTTOM LEFT: ONE amber marble sphere with a very clear thin dark green rim, simple matte rounded look, not transparent, centered. BOTTOM MIDDLE: ONE glowing round orange paper lantern with cream panels and tiny orange tassel on a short hook, bold simple completion sticker, no surrounding geometry. BOTTOM RIGHT: ONE bright raspberry-colored flat round glass button with 4 rounded inward petals, single clear outline, straight down overhead, intentionally distinct from the octagonal game pieces, independent math quiz asset. No shadows beyond the silhouette, no shared shapes, no additional objects.
